This can in no wise be achieved except through the power of a skilled, an all-powerful and inspired Physician.

order.why: Read human oneness as a remedy for a collective illness.
shortened: The body of the human world is sick. Its remedy and healing will be the oneness of the kingdom of humanity. Its life is the Most Great Peace.

order.why: Keep the renewed call to the remedy.
Read the reported connection among peace, religion and reason.
Consider the supplied image of moderation healing the world.
Place peace within the full set of teachings.
shortened: The first plan "the alliance of Humanity for the attainment of Universal Peace" did not bring any result: for the question of Universal Peace is one Teaching of the Teachings of His Holiness Baha'u'llah, It must be along the Principles of the Bahais and not the Principles of the Bahais to be along (or consider as of secondary importance to) the question of Universal Peace.

order.why: Read the reported program across economic, spiritual and institutional life.
Connect peace with economic relations, equality and science.
Read the related enumeration of knowledge and equality.
Join religious understanding and science to unity.
shortened: It is the Cause of love and amity amongst mankind. It establishes communication between various religions and different nations. It removed all antagonism. Therefore when this Cause is fully spread in Europe, warfare will be the thing of the past, universal Peace will be realized, the oneness of the world of humanity will be practiced, religion and science will work hand in hand.

order.why: Test religion by its contribution to fellowship.
Consider religious love as an answer to the fire of war.
shortened: Quench ye the fires of war, lift high the banners of peace, work for the oneness of humankind and remember that religion is the channel of love unto all peoples.

order.why: Examine conviction as a sustaining source of effort.
shortened: Despite this, we have in no wise relented, but have continued to endeavour unto this very moment and are increasing our efforts as day followeth day, because our desire for peace is not derived merely from the intellect: It is a matter of religious belief and one of the eternal foundations of the Faith of God.

order.why: Confront the power needed amid glorification of militarism.
Keep the reported account of political helplessness attributed.
Consider the claimed power to moderate differences.
Read the reported reliance on the Holy Spirit.
shortened: The Holy Spirit is the only power which will ultimately unite and harmonize the races and nations of the world. The Cause of God is the only panacea which will heal for all time to come the social, economic and political diseases of mankind. The revelation of Baha'u'llah is the tree which will send its outstretched branched to all the countries and under its cool shade all the religious sects will gather there to fraternize and associate with one another.

order.why: Examine the reported basis for lasting peace.
Retain the interpretation of Christ’s appearance and the Word of God.
Join friendship with peace workers to the stated need for spiritual power.
Locate the Word as the source of the hoped-for change.
Read the establishment of the Kingdom through the Holy Spirit.
shortened: The Kingdom of God was established in the world of existence through the power of the Word of God and the confirmation of the Holy Spirit, and the lights of peace and reconciliation dawned forth from the Sun of Truth. Ere long will its rays illumine both East and West.

order.why: Hold the image of dawn beside the still-unrealized fullness.
shortened: My hope is that soon it will be established as it ought to be and should be. Now it is the beginning of dawn, a little light has appeared, but through the penetration of the Word of God, the reality of universal peace will shine forth like the sun.

order.why: Distinguish first light from the completed day.
shortened: Never did anyone imagine that humanity would yearn for divine unity, that the banner of universal peace would be raised at the pole of the horizons, and likewise with the other divine teachings--it was never thought possible. Now the world's great ones and people of influence are striving with utmost effort to implement the divine teachings. Yet this is only the beginning dawn; after this dawn comes the true morning, and after morning the rising of the Sun of Truth. Then will universal peace pitch its tent at the pole of the horizons, and all divine teachings will be implemented.

order.why: Keep the similar expectation of a future dawn.
shortened: Praise be to God that the dawn of peace and reconciliation has broken. We hope that in future the sun of world-peace shall in accordance with heavenly Teachings, rise in full splendor from the horizon of the world.

order.why: Make room for gradual human readiness.
shortened: Whatever has issued from the Supreme Pen will surely become manifest and evident, but humanity as a whole is not yet ready for this blessing. Gradually, this heavenly gift will dawn from the horizon of spirit and consciousness, and when this luminous ray reaches its zenith in the exalted firmament, the intense darkness will vanish and the divine lights of unity will encompass the earth's expanse.

order.why: Preserve the reported question about the process of establishing peace.
Read the reported challenge to resignation about human nature.
Move into the individual contribution and its obstacles.
Name the prejudices to be overcome.
Return to the breadth of that removal.
Examine inherited imitations as barriers.
shortened: Destroy the mot of conflict and strife; abandon imitations and prejudices which lead to cruelty, so that you may acknowledge the Truth and the light of the oneness of humanity may shine brilliant and manifest as the sun; the standard of universal peace be hoisted; perfect love and harmony may reign among the races, religions and nations; and the world of man may find peace and acquire a divine image and likeness.

order.why: Seek reform that extinguishes fanaticism.
shortened: He has had and has no purpose except the reformation of the world and all that is therein, that perchance the world-consuming sun of ignorant fanaticism may be extinguished and the East and West of the world may become connected and united in all respects.

order.why: Keep the reported cost of old prejudices.
Include equality of women with the removal of other prejudices.
shortened: Now that women have been stirred to action in this century, they must keep this in view: to promote universal peace, to manifest the unity of humanity, to make human virtues shine forth, to connect the hearts of nations, to remove religious and sectarian prejudice, eliminate gender prejudice, abolish political prejudice, and lift away national prejudice.

order.why: Read women’s political participation in relation to war.
Receive the prayerful encouragement to women.
Hear women’s love and music in the work of peace.
shortened: O maidservants of God! Now is the time to take hold of the viol of love, raise the melody of the Kingdom of God, eradicate war and lay the foundation for peace.

order.why: Put knowledge at the service of peace.
Imagine scholarship as an army for peace.
shortened: The thoughts of universal Peace must be instilled in the minds of all the scholars, - in order that they may become the armies of Peace, the real servants of the body politic - the world.

order.why: Read Esperanto within the effort to overcome misunderstanding.
Join a shared language to understanding of hearts.
Read language alongside universal brotherhood.
shortened: This is the day of universal peace, of universal brotherhood, of a universal language and of the union of all religions.

order.why: Keep the historical hope for a common language after war.
shortened: Universal Peace will be established; the Oneness of the World of Humanity will be established. No war will remain. The Teachings of God will be promulgated. One language will be adopted and spread. Misunderstandings will pass away and it will be very good."

order.why: Read the wolf and lamb through reconciliation among peoples.
Consider the interpretation of Isaiah through justice and one homeland.
shortened: The five continents of the world will become as one, its diverse nations will become one nation, the earth will become one homeland, and the human race will become one people.

Universal peace will raise its pavilion in the midmost heart of creation and the blessed Tree of Life will so grow and flourish as to stretch its sheltering shade over the East and the West. Strong and weak, rich and poor, contending kindreds and hostile nations--which are like the wolf and the lamb, the leopard and kid, the lion and the calf--will treat one another with the utmost love, unity, justice and equity.

order.why: Examine the example of formerly divided religious communities in Persia.
Join religious unity to equality.
Read the reported responsibility of religious leaders to bind hearts.
shortened: The leaders of religions must be the means of binding the hearts together, establishing good-fellowship between the members of the human family, creating a desire for universal Peace and emphasizing more the essential unity of mankind.

order.why: Consider the community’s freedom from prejudice as an example.
Test the claims of civilization through qualities and conduct.
shortened: Praise be to God that the Baha'is are successful in demonstrating qualities and conduct that are admired by all peoples and are the cause of proclaiming the oneness of humanity and promoting universal peace. Today this is the greatest foundation of true civilization and the cause of tranquility in the world of creation.

order.why: Read the reported hope for a recognizable public character.
Keep the reported call to virtues and service concrete.
shortened: In brief, you must become distinguished for all the virtues of the human world; for faithfulness and sincerity, for justice and fidelity, for firmness and steadfastness, for philanthropic deeds and service to the human world, for love toward every human being, for unity and accord with all people, for removing prejudices and promoting international peace. Finally, you must become distinguished for heavenly illumination and acquiring the bestowals of God.

order.why: Retain the supplied account of education toward discernment and virtue.
shortened: After a man has come under the care of the Teachers, after he has perceived and understood the nature of man in its purity, then, having gained discrimination, he learns what virtue is.

order.why: Read the supplied image of purity amid distraction.
Enter the historical warnings about European armaments.
shortened: Also three years before the outbreak of the world war 'Abdu'l-Baha travelled to America and most of Europe, where he raised His voice before all gatherings, societies and churches, appealing: O ye assemblage of men! The continent of Europe hath virtually become an arsenal filled with explosives. There are vast stores of destructive material hidden underground, liable to burst forth at a single spark, causing the whole earth to quake.

order.why: Keep Europe’s arsenal within that warning.
Read the reported image of armed camps.
Hear the urgency of the reported appeal before catastrophe.
Ask what prevention of the causes of war would require.
Keep the Balkan catastrophe and its destroyed families in view.
Read the reported plea concerning the Balkan War and the rights involved.
shortened: May the Balkan War come to an end and the rights of both sides be preserved and protected, otherwise its spark will engulf the world, especially Europe which is like an ammunition depot full of inflammatory materials waiting for one spark to turn Europe upside down. Thus there remains no solution except universal peace. Today this is the greatest of matters.

order.why: Retain the supplied hope for reconciliation in the Balkans.
Trace conflict to ignorance in the reported battlefield account.
Consider war as an assault upon the human edifice.
Keep the reported prohibition of war in its source setting.
shortened: Without the inculcation of these principles mutual understanding and conciliation between the nations will not be realized. For instance the greatest evil of this century is war. In the Bahai teaching war is prohibited. The greatest need of this century is universal peace. Baha Ollah has instituted it. The most urgent need of human kind is the declaration of the oneness of the world of humanity, this is the first principle of the Bahai Teachings.

order.why: Read war-weariness as an opening toward peace.
shortened: Similarly, the dawn of universal peace shall appear and gradually its sun will shine forth, and humanity will find rest and tranquility, and the light of love will illumine East and West. In any case, because of this bloody war all humanity has become weary of war and a wonderful readiness for universal peace has been achieved.

order.why: Hear the related postwar thirst for peace.
Keep the historical expectation of an initial peace.
shortened: This world-war has come to an end. We trust that at least it will lead to the preliminaries of Universal Peace, as it is manifestly forewarned in the Blessed Tablets.

order.why: Read the reported account of suffering and learning.
Retain the reported interpretation of war’s political consequences.
Keep the reported expectation of war accelerating peace attributed.
shortened: He said:

If the republics of the Americas assembled and agreed on the question of peace, and if all of them would turn to the [Peace] Assembly at the Hague, most of the powers of Europe would follow suit. But looking at it from another point of view, if an international war breaks out in Europe, international peace will be established more quickly.

order.why: Receive the supplied prediction of peace after upheavals.
Retain the reported hope of promoting peace after the war.
Keep the reported expectation about diminishing war in its historical context.
shortened: From now on lesser and lesser will be the magic spell of war, greater and greater will be the influence of Peace. The day is coming when the Dove of Peace shall reign over all the continent, the laws of Peace shall rule all the nations and the resources of war will be expended over that which would be conducive to the spiritualization of mankind.

order.why: Read the reported account of the Tsar’s peace initiative.
shortened: Our Lord said that the Blessed Perfection had revealed secretly in a Tablet some words about Universal Peace. And also, just before His Ascension, He had revealed another Tablet about the Universal Peace which should prevail between all the peoples of the world. We now see the effect of these words spoken by the Blessed Perfection, in the fact that the Czar of Russia has called all nations to a Peace Conference, and in the various societies and organizations for promoting peace which are now in this world.

order.why: Keep the reported discussion of peace congresses.
shortened: In peace congresses and conferences of nations we raised high the call of the Ancient Beauty and spoke of that which promotes universal peace and advances the unity of the human world, to such an extent that in every gathering all necks were bowed, tongues opened in praise, hearts were attracted to the breaths of God, and souls were gladdened by the glad-tidings of God.

order.why: Recall the Tablets addressed to rulers.
shortened: Among the principles of divine civilization He came to proclaim is the Most Great Peace of mankind.
He wrote special Epistles covering these facts to all the kings and rulers of nations.

order.why: Read the reported opposition to those appeals.
shortened: He wrote to Victoria, Queen of Great Britain, the Czar of Russia, the Emperor of Germany, Napoleon III of France and others, inviting them to world unity and peace. Through a heavenly power He was enabled to promulgate these ideals in the Orient. Kings could not withstand Him. They endeavored to extinguish His light but served only to increase its intensity and illumination.

order.why: Retain the supplied account of proclaiming peace to rulers.
Keep the reported historical claim about the origin of the idea attributed.
Hear the command to peace beside its rejection.
shortened: We have enjoined upon mankind the Most Great Peace that the world and its people might find rest, but they cast the command of God behind their backs and followed the ways of the corrupt ones.

order.why: Remember imprisonment borne for unity.
shortened: Unto the emblems of justice and the exponents of equity it is indubitably clear and evident that this Wronged One, strengthened by the transcendent power of the Kingdom, is seeking to efface from among the peoples and kindreds of the earth every evidence of disorder, discord, dissension, differences or divisions; and it is for no other reason but this great, this momentous object that He hath again and again been cast into prison and many a day and a night hath been subjected to chains and fetters.

order.why: Retain the supplied account of the sacred tent and its contested use.
shortened: Now that sacred Tent which belonged to the Manifestation of God, the tent under which the Surat-El-Heiykal, the Ketab-El-Akdas and other glorious Tablets were revealed, the tent which was hallowed by the presence of the Sun of Reality, that tent of the Lord which was predicted by the prophets to be raised on the plain of Acca and on Mount Carmel, the tent under which international Congresses of humanity must be convened in the future and the Flag of Universal Peace waving over it - I say this tent is given by the violators of the Covenant to Jamal Pasha, the general of the Syrian Army.

order.why: Read the hope placed in America as a capacity to be exercised.
Join the efforts of people and government with prayer.
shortened: May the American people and their government unite in their efforts in order that this light may dawn from this point and spread to all regions, for this is one of the greatest bestowals of God. In order that America may avail herself of this opportunity, I beg that you strive and pray with heart and soul, devoting all your energies to this end: that the banner of international peace may be upraised here and that this democracy may be the cause of the cessation of warfare in all other countries.

order.why: Keep the reported hope concerning Bryan in its time.
Retain the particular historical praise of Bryan.
shortened: The people of America are distinguished above the nations of Europe in this glorious aim, namely universal peace, and it is fitting that they take pride over all nations. Especially Mr. William Bryan, Secretary of State of the United States, who has truly arisen with the utmost effort to promote universal peace and who strives in this regard according to the teachings of Baha'u'llah and who is sacrificing his life in this cause.

order.why: Read the reported praise of America in context.
shortened: America has arisen to spread the teachings of peace, to increase the illumination of humankind and bestow happiness and prosperity upon the children of men. These are the principles and evidences of divine civilization. America is a noble nation, the standard-bearer of peace throughout the world, shedding light to all regions.

order.why: Keep the related historical claim about its peaceful character attributed.
Examine the condition attached to America’s role.
shortened: As Americans are removed from most political difficulties they live at ease in isolation and, compared to most other regions, are more desirous of peace and harmony, so they can succeed in bringing about universal peace provided they arise as they should and the nation and government put forth strenuous efforts and, through spiritual power, carry out the divine teachings and principles.

order.why: Read the hope that influence may radiate outward.
Retain the supplied praise of treaties and statesmen in its historical setting.
shortened: Today the United States is leading the forces of good will and fraternity and during the last years her far-sighted Presidents and statesmen have proposed many fundamental Peace plans, the highest ideals of which are embodied in epoch-making treaties entered in good faith with several nations. This in itself is a most hopeful sign and insures ultimate success to the Cause of Peace.

order.why: Keep the supplied statement of America’s capacity.
Read the supplied appeal to Canada’s people in its national setting.
shortened: I have come to America to speak a message of peace and good-will to you. You are a noble nation with a just government. I beg of God that this just and fair land may assist in working for the peace of the world. Let the people of this young and noble nation assist in the great movement for the peace and unity of the world.

order.why: Retain the supplied encouragement to persevere in international peace.
shortened: Praise God, this nation at this time is striving with all its energy for International Peace. Rest not from your endeavors until international peace become established.

order.why: Keep the question about the American journey with its answer.
Read the reported purpose of the journey.
shortened: I have come to America to raise the standard of universal peace and to promote the unity of mankind. My aim is to create love and harmony among the religions.

order.why: Retain the supplied explanation to reporters.
Keep the question about teachers’ purpose with its practical answer.
Read the reported gathering as service beyond national boundaries.
shortened: It is my fond and fervent hope through the favor of God that this present meeting may be instrumental in ushering in the day when the standard of the oneness of the world of humanity shall be held aloft in America. May it be the first real foundation of international peace, having for its object universal service to man.

order.why: Consider professions and public office as opportunities to serve all nations.
Keep the supplied hope about representatives’ influence for peace.
Read the supplied alternative to hostile treatment among rulers.
Retain the supplied concern about military aggression against the Islamic world.
Keep the reported hope for the Ottoman peoples’ unity.
shortened: After this journey, the call of the unity of humanity and universal peace must be upraised in the Ottoman territories. Their turn shall come; perhaps an effort will be made to unite their various peoples.

order.why: Read the particular encouragement to gatherings in Germany.
shortened: In Germany numerous gatherings were held where on one side was raised the banner of universal peace and on the other the blessed flag of Iran.

order.why: Retain the further hope addressed to the German friends.
shortened: One hopes that all friends in Germany may drink from this divine cup and raise the banner of universal peace.

order.why: Read the supplied hopes for Persia’s moral and scientific development.
Keep the supplied vision of Iran’s institutions, arts and peace together.
Retain the particular letter to a peace conference president.
shortened: O thou esteemed personage! subjects.displayTitle: Prayer: bringing the whole of life before God
subjects.introduction: The honest beginning of prayer may be an admission: I do not know what will help or harm me. Bahá’u’lláh puts those words in the mouth of the one who prays and then asks God to ordain what is good in every world, so that not knowing becomes the opening of trust. A whole life can be carried to that threshold, grief and debt, the knots in one’s affairs, the fear of being left alone at night, and the slow turning of a wish for relief into a wish to be steadfast, discerning and useful to others. Prayer also widens outward, to a sorrowing woman, to prisoners and exiles, to a city, to a world burning with war and in need of pardon. Jesus taught that a few words joining daily bread with forgiveness and the will of God are enough, and Psalm 13 shows that a long lament can end in song without ceasing to be honest. Prayers for assistance, for healing and forgiveness, for detachment and for service open the paths that run on from here.

Besides Thee there is no helper and other than Thee there is no succorer. We place our hope in Thee and trust in Thee.
