order.why: Keep the prayer for the sorrowful Leaf within its setting.
Receive remembrance from prison as comfort for a woman.
shortened: O My handmaiden, My handmaiden! Rejoice thou in that the Wronged One remembereth thee from His prison, and calleth upon thee with both His outward and inner tongue, saying:

O Lord of the worlds and Beloved of the nations! I beseech Thee by the Name through Whose manifestation all things were attracted, and the Nightingale sang upon the branches of the Uttermost Tree, to ordain for Thy handmaiden that which shall solace her eyes, gladden her heart and dilate her breast.

order.why: Hear the related petition for her tranquility.
shortened: Moreover, I beseech Thee, O Lord of all beings and King of the throne on high and of earth below, to send down upon Thy handmaiden from the heaven of Thy bounty that which shall solace her eyes, gladden her heart and bring tranquility to her being.

order.why: Keep the simple request for gladness.
shortened: Ordain for me, O my God, that which will solace mine eyes and gladden my heart.

order.why: Join tranquility to strength amid opposition.
shortened: I beseech Thee by the suns of the heavens of Thy gifts and favors, and by the pearls hidden in the sea of Thy knowledge and wisdom, to ordain for me that which will solace mine eyes, gladden my heart and dilate my breast. O Lord! Change my weakness into strength through Thy power, and my agitation into tranquility through Thy assurance, in such wise that the mutterings of the oppressors and the clamoring of the deniers may not hold me back.

order.why: Read consolation alongside illumination and expansion of heart.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O Lord of the worlds, by Thy Most Great Name, to ordain for me that whereby my eyes may be consoled, my heart illumined and my breast dilated.

order.why: Let joy include the awakening of inner vision.
shortened: O Lord! Grant glad-tidings to the souls and bestow joy upon the hearts. Give light to the eyes and grant divine radiance to the inner vision.

order.why: Pray for the peace of hearts and radiance of faces.
Remember those who loved a person who suffered exile and imprisonment.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O my Lord, by him and by his exile and his imprisonment, to send down upon such as loved him what will quiet their hearts and bless their works.

order.why: Join sorrow’s relief to understanding.
shortened: Now, O my Lord, illumine this lowly one with manifest knowledge, and cause this sorrowful one to shine bright in the luminous horizon.

order.why: Ask for a way forward and a lamp for the journey.
shortened: O Lord! Open for him a way out, establish for him a path, and light for him a brilliant lamp in the glass of life.

order.why: Retain the prayer of weariness and the entrusting of a burden.
shortened: O Lord! Lighten this mighty burden and grant me relief by delivering this trust into Your hands, O my Generous Lord. Make me one of Your successful servants and Your slaves who are delivered from the depths of the seas of tribulation and the abysses of the ocean of calamities, who attain the supreme triumph and the honor of meeting You in Your Most Glorious Kingdom.

order.why: Keep the longing for reunion in its devotional setting.
Read the prayer for martyrdom as this source’s particular expression of longing.
shortened: O my God, my God! Thou seest me prostrate in the dust of humility and self-effacement, supplicating toward the Kingdom of Thy oneness, agitated in the wilderness of abasement and distress, beseeching the dominion of Thy singleness, while tears stream from mine eyes in anguish in the desert of deprivation, yearning to attain Thy presence.
O Lord! Ordain for me the chalice of supreme martyrdom and ascension to the proximity of Thy mercy, O Thou Creator of earth and heaven!

order.why: Remember the speaker’s imprisonment and turning toward mercy.
shortened: Thou beholdest, O my God, Thy servant who dwelleth in this prison-house, wholly detached from any one but Thee, his eyes turned in the direction of the Day-Spring of Thy mercy, his heart longing for the wondrous manifestations of Thy grace.

order.why: Practice waiting upon bounty.
shortened: O my Lord! Thou seest me awaiting the wonders of Thy bounty and the manifestations of Thy mercy. I beseech Thee to ordain for me the best of what lieth with Thee.

order.why: Keep the related appeal of expectation.
shortened: O Lord! Thou seest me turning toward Thee, awaiting the wonders of Thy bounty and generosity. I beseech Thee not to disappoint me from the rain of Thy mercy in Thy days and the waves of the ocean of Thy bounty and bestowal.

order.why: Return to the limits of personal knowledge.
Entrust affairs to a knowledge beyond one’s own.
shortened: Then set right, O my God, all our affairs and ordain for us what is best for us. I testify that Thou knowest better than we what benefits us, and that Thou art the Mighty, the Exalted, the Most High, the Most Great.

order.why: Ask for what is best after giving thanks for guidance.
Explore contentment through the image of divine decree.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which, when Thou didst call it to the heaven, countless suns rose from its horizon, and when Thou didst cast it upon the seas, they surged in remembrance of Thy Most Exalted Name, and when Thou didst cast it upon all the trees, they brought forth the fruits of Thy knowledge and the produce of Thy bounty, and bore witness unto them once through Thy most wondrous and most sweet tongue - whereupon the Hour was established - that Thou mayest make me content with whatsoever Thou hast ordained through the Most Glorious Pen upon the Tablet of Decree.

order.why: Read contentment as a hope for every condition.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O Creator of heaven, O Thou through Whose might the earth was cleft asunder and the heaven was rent apart, and through Whose loving-kindness the countenance of all things was made to smile, to ordain that I may in all conditions remain content with what Thou hast through Thy bounty and generosity ordained for me.

order.why: Join acceptance with a steady gaze and detachment.
Move from contentment toward gratitude.
shortened: Say: My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having guided me and illumined my heart with the light of Thy knowledge. I beseech Thee, O God of Names, by Thy Will that hath encompassed all existence both seen and unseen, and by Thy Name whereby Thou hast subdued hearts and minds, and by the waves of the ocean of Thy bounty and the splendors of the Day-Star of Thy grace, to make me content with what is with Thee, nay rather, grateful for what hath been sent down from Thy decree.

order.why: Receive awakening as a reason for trust in the divine will.
shortened: "My God, my God! Praise be unto Thee for having awakened me through the breezes of the dawn of Thy manifestation and raised me up when Thy servants and creatures were thunderstruck. I beseech Thee by the light of Thy Cause which hath shone forth from the horizon of the heaven of Thy will, and by the Word whereby Thou hast subdued the hearts of Thy loved ones, to make me in all conditions hold fast unto Thy will, cling to the hem of Thy decree, and be content with that which Thou hast ordained for me through Thy bounty and grace.

order.why: Examine the claimed movement from personal will to divine good-pleasure.
shortened: This is Thy servant who, when the fragrances of the holy breeze of Thy Sovereign Oneness wafted forth, sought intercession through the Manifestations of the glory of Thy Lordship, and fled from himself and from all else save Thee unto the wondrous grace of the King of Thy forgiveness. He claimeth to have turned away from self and passion unto Thy most glorious, most gracious and most enduring realms, and from his own will unto Thy will, and from his good pleasure unto Thy good pleasure.

order.why: Keep the whole being’s turning toward nearness.
Join weakness and trust in power beyond oneself.
shortened: O my Lord! I am weak: yet have I laid hold upon Thy Name, the Powerful, the Mighty. Do Thou destine for me by Thy grace that which shall profit me both in this world and in the world to come.

order.why: Consider the drop and ocean image of dependence on grace.
Read strength, healing and dignity as gifts to the vulnerable.
shortened: Lord! Make the weak among them mighty in Thy service, the lowly honored in Thy Kingdom, the poor wealthy with the treasures of Thy bestowal, the captive a prince through the power of Thy sovereignty, the sick healed of ailments, and the frail possessed of power and might.

order.why: Receive shelter, nourishment and love in one petition.
Include young and old beneath the same care.
Let protection open into mercy and expanded hearts.
shortened: O Lord! Have mercy on Thy loved ones and preserve Thy chosen ones in the fortress of Thy protection and the strongholds of Thy preservation and guardianship. Open before their faces the doors of Thy mercy and expand their breasts through the signs of Thy bounty and send down upon them a blessing from Thy presence.

order.why: Seek shelter amid the upheaval described in the prayer.
shortened: Say:

O my Lord, the Mighty, the Loving! I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which the lands were shaken and the servants were troubled and through which Thou didst distinguish between all created things, to protect me beneath the shadow of Thy great mercy.

order.why: Retain the personified Hour’s petition against terror.
shortened: This is the Day wherein the Hour proclaimeth and saith: O God of the Kingdom and the Dominion! I beseech Thee by the power through which Thou didst subdue the world, to protect me from the terror of this Day.

order.why: Read the gathered souls under the banner of favor.
Remember old friends with affection and sweetness.
Receive the blessing of morning and evening radiance.
Keep the assurance of supplication at the Shrine.
shortened: I supplicate and implore in the Holy Shrine and the Most Exalted Station, seeking for you boundless aid and favor.

order.why: Read continuing prayer as care even when letters are delayed.
Enter the Bab’s sustained testimony to divine names and sovereignty.
shortened: I bear witness, and all things bear witness, that Thou art God, there is no God but Thee, alone with no partner. Thine is the Kingdom and the Dominion, Thine is might and omnipotence, Thine is power and divinity, Thine is strength and earthly dominion, Thine is glory and majesty, Thine is the countenance and beauty, Thine is the face and perfection, Thine is mercy and bounty, Thine is sovereignty and justice, Thine are the symbols and parables, Thine are the stations and grandeur, Thine is greatness and independence, Thine is guardianship and sublimity, Thine is might and invincibility, Thine is guardianship and transcendence, Thine is dominion and power, and Thine is whatsoever Thou hast loved or wilt love in the kingdom of Thy Cause and creation.

order.why: Read the Bab’s praise beyond all created descriptions.
Hear the Bab’s many forms of petition through the divine attributes.
Keep the blessing upon Muhammad and his family with its servant-Creator distinction.
Receive the Bab’s celebration of the hour of manifestation.
Read the Bab’s request for entry into Paradise by mercy.
Keep the Bab’s appeal for a truthful judgment.
Begin the Baha’u’llah selections of praise with the light of the Most Great Name.
A supplication for assistance through divine names and attributes.
Give thanks for the Day of overflowing generosity.
Respond to a received Tablet with outer and inner gratitude.
Remember awakening, learning and guidance as received gifts.
shortened: My God, my God! Unto Thee be praise and thanksgiving, and unto Thee be gratitude and bounty, for having caused me to hasten unto Thy good-pleasure and to hold fast unto the cord of Thy grace. Thou art He Who, O my God, didst awaken me when I was asleep, and taught me when I was ignorant, and guided me unto Thy path, and strengthened me to make mention of Thee and to praise Thee.

order.why: Join gratitude for guidance with a renewed request for bounty.
Keep the acknowledgment of guidance and hope.
shortened: Say: Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having guided me unto Thy manifest and evident path and for having sent down unto me that which hath testified to my turning toward Thy luminous horizon. I beseech Thee not to disappoint me of what lieth with Thee. Verily, Thou art the Most Merciful of the merciful ones.

order.why: Read the directed prayer after receiving verses.
shortened: Praise be unto Thee, O my God and my Desire, for having made me to know Thy Day, and caused me to hear Thy Call, and shown me the traces of Thy Most Exalted Pen, whereby all things were attracted. I beseech Thee, O Light of the hearts of them that seek Thee, by Thy sealed Wine and Thine irrevocable Command, to make me strong through Thy power, that the might of the people may not prevent me from turning to the splendors of Thy countenance and gazing toward Thine horizon.

order.why: Give thanks for remembrance while heedless and asleep.
shortened: When thou dost inhale the fragrance of My utterance and hearest My call, turn thy face toward the House and say: "My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having guided me when I was heedless, and remembered me when I was silent, and awakened me [when I was] sleeping, and taught me when I was ignorant. I beseech Thee, O Lord of existence and Sovereign of the seen and unseen, by Thy Name through which Thou didst manifest that which was hidden in Thy knowledge and treasured in the repositories of Thy wisdom, to make me steadfast in Thy Cause and firm in Thy love in such wise that the cawing of the cawers and the clamor of the transgressors shall not deter me.

order.why: Seek learning that benefits every world of life.
shortened: When thou dost behold the waves of the ocean of My utterance and art attracted by the choice wine of My bounty, say:

"My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having guided me unto Thy straight path and Thy mighty announcement. I beseech Thee by the Word through which Thou didst reveal the decree of the Trumpet, causing those in the kingdoms of knowledge and learning to swoon away, to teach me that which will benefit me in every world of Thy worlds.

order.why: Keep the related instruction to respond to revelation.
shortened: When you attain unto the fragrances of revelation and drink the choice wine of utterance from the cup of mystical understanding, say:

"Praise be unto Thee, O my God, my Purpose and my Beloved, for having guided me to Thy straight path and made me aware of Thy mighty announcement. I beseech Thee, O Lord of the world and Educator of the nations, by Thy irrevocable Command which hath encompassed earth and heaven, to ordain for me through Thy Most Exalted Pen that which shall profit me in all the worlds of Thy worlds.

order.why: Retain the personal address about the gift of recognition.
shortened: These words were heard, but the tongue of the All-Merciful speaks thus: O friend! Give praise to the Beloved of the world Who has enabled you to recognize the Hidden Mystery and the Treasured Secret. If this bounty that was bestowed upon you had been bestowed upon all the peoples of the world, all would have turned to the Friend and gathered beneath the shade of the Tree. That which was not given to them was given to you, for their past deeds have deprived and excluded them from God's infinite bounties.

order.why: Read the direct call to a handmaiden to give thanks.
shortened: O My handmaiden! Hearken unto the call of thy Lord from the direction of the Throne, then give thanks and prostrate thyself before Me, then remember and be devoutly obedient and be thou among the thankful women.

order.why: Keep the blessing of faith and deeds beside thanksgiving.
shortened: Blessed is the handmaiden who has attained to faith and acted according to what she was commanded by the All-Merciful.
Be thou grateful and say: Praise be to Thee, O Quickener of the worlds!

order.why: Receive a person’s gratitude and prayer for inner vision amid physical blindness.
shortened: O Thou kind Beloved! In humble supplication and in the language of the Kingdom every limb and member of my body uttereth praise and thanks unto Thee.  With every hair of my head I magnify Thy Name, and from every hilltop I raise my voice in proclaiming Thee.  May my life be offered up for every veteran servant of Thine, and my being be made a sacrifice to Thy most sweet Call.  Since Thou hast withheld from me physical sight in this mortal world, deprive me not of  penetrating vision in the celestial realm, O Thou Who art forgiving and loving.

order.why: Read the joy of a gathered company receiving spiritual life.
Ask for love already present to become more alive.
shortened: Gladden the bosom wherein the fire of Thy love doth smolder, and set it aglow with the flame of Thy celestial love and spirit.
Robe the tabernacles of divine unity with the vesture of holiness, and set upon my head the crown of Thy favor.

order.why: Receive spring as a season of grace and reunion.
Imagine each leaf waiting for mercy’s breeze.
shortened: O my God! Every leaf of the leaves of the Tree of Thy love desireth that the breezes of Thy mercy might pass over it. Therefore, it behooveth Thy grace and bounty to send upon it that which will attract it through Thy Name and move it through Thy love.

order.why: Read love and remembrance through the image of consuming fire.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Thy Name, He Who bore every affliction in Thy path and imprisoned Himself to manifest Thy Cause and exalt Thy sovereignty among the people of Thy realm, to make me one of the pure ones who have been set ablaze by the fire of Thy love and whose hearts have been consumed by the heat of Thy remembrance.

order.why: Join the wine of oneness to praise among others.
Seek entrance and quickening through the Holy Spirit.
shortened: Admit us into Thy Kingdom of holiness and quicken us through the breaths of the Holy Spirit.

order.why: A prayer for strength, knowledge, freedom from self and sincere service.
Give the longing for meeting its own place.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Thy presence to honor me with meeting Thee and draw me nigh unto the ocean of Thy reunion, O Thou Goal of them that know Thee."

order.why: Read the petition for union and presence.
Remember the hope for an approaching reunion.
shortened: I beseech God, glorified be His majesty, and hope that He will soon ordain reunion and not deprive us of the blessing of meeting, by the truth of His Prophets and Messengers and their Lord and Master.

order.why: Keep the concise request for meeting again.
shortened: Then beseech God that He may bring about a reunion between us and you, for verily He hath power over all things.

order.why: Receive the aspiration to circle the throne and attain presence.
Read the requested reward of nearness.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Name and Thy Most Ancient Light to ordain for me the reward of those who have attained unto Thy presence and drawn nigh unto Thee by Thy leave.

order.why: Confront the prison of one’s own imaginings.
Place release from self beside release from a physical prison.
Let repeated remembrance accompany release from desire.
shortened: I pray to Thee at the break of day and at nightfall, and mention Thy Name at morn and eventide, and supplicate to Thee at daytime and night season that Thou may draw me out of the depths of my corrupt desires and deliver me from this dark abyss and attract me to Thy most glorious kingdom and detach me, every day and every night, from all else but Thee.

order.why: Ask that the bond of love endure while veils of self are removed.
Seek cleansing that makes recognition possible.
shortened: Rain down, I beseech Thee, from the clouds of Thine overflowing grace, that which shall cleanse the hearts of Thy servants from whatever may prevent their beholding Thy face, or may prevent them from turning unto Thee, that they may all recognize Him Who is their Fashioner and Creator.

order.why: Read purification in relation to good-pleasure.
shortened: Thou seest me, O my God, turning unto Thee and speaking Thy praise and glory. I beseech Thee to make me purified from all that Thy good-pleasure abhorreth and to ordain for me what beseemeth the heaven of Thy grace and bounty.

order.why: Include the women of a land in the prayer for sanctification.
Imagine detached hearing as preparation to listen.
Seek wisdom for outer and inner life.
Ask not to be withheld from knowledge and favor.
shortened: Hold fast unto the cord of thy Lord's loving-kindness and say: O God of Names and Creator of heaven! I beseech Thee by Thy grace not to withhold from me the outpourings of the ocean of Thy knowledge, nor to banish me from the shadow of Thy favor.

order.why: Pray for guidance and understanding of what is desired.
shortened: Ordain through Thy Most Exalted Pen that which will make known to them Thy path and will guide them to Thy way and will teach them what Thou hast desired for them through Thy generosity and grace.

order.why: Keep the concluding mosque prayer’s request for knowledge and direction.
Give the cry for divine guidance its urgency.
shortened: O God, my God! Thou beholdest Thy servants in the abyss of perdition and error; where is Thy light of divine guidance, O Thou the Desire of the world?

order.why: Extend prayer toward deniers and the heedless.
shortened: I beseech Thee by the ocean of Thy grace and the heaven of Thy generosity, and by that which was treasured in Thy knowledge and hidden in the stronghold of Thy protection, and by the pearls concealed in the treasuries of Thy Most Exalted Pen, and by the lights of Thy countenance, O Lord of all beings and Sovereign of the throne on high and of the dust beneath, to aid the deniers to turn, and the rejecters to acknowledge, and the heedless to return unto the court of Thy mercy and to repent before the gate of Thy pardon and forgiveness.

order.why: Join return and blessing with acting upon guidance.
shortened: O Lord! Assist the heedless to turn unto Thee and to arise before the gate of Thy grandeur.

O Lord! Send down from the clouds of Thy generosity upon those who have turned to Thee and acted according to that which Thou hast commanded them in Thy Book a token of Thy grace and a mercy from Thy presence.

order.why: Read the appeal for return through the remembrance of suffering.
shortened: O Lord my Lord! I beseech Thee by Thy tribulations and imprisonment and by what hath befallen Thee in the prison-city of Ta, and by the lights of Thy Revelation and the stations that have been honored by Thy footsteps and the cities that have been illumined by the radiance of Thy countenance and the things that have been adorned by Thy glance and the air wherein arose Thy sighs at what hath befallen Thy loved ones, to assist Thy servants to return unto Thee.

order.why: Retain the prayer’s strong language concerning transgression without softening it.
Ask for a lamp that endures beyond present circumstances.
shortened: O Lord of all beings! I beseech Thee by the power of Thy Finger whereby Thou didst rend asunder the veils of idle fancies and the shrouds of vain imaginings, and by the pearls of the ocean of Thy knowledge and the mysteries of Thy wisdom, to ordain for me that which shall be as a lamp unto me in every world of Thy worlds. Moreover, decree for me and for Thy loved ones, through Thy bounty and generosity, that which shall profit them.

order.why: Read the childlike prayer for spiritual growth.
Join gladness and love with the dedication of an entire life.
Ask that deeds bear the ornament of good-pleasure.
shortened: O my Lord! I am Thy servant and the son of Thy servant, hoping for the wonders of Thy grace. I beseech Thee by Thy Cause through whose manifestation the ocean of bounty surged and the fragrance of Thy gracious Name, O Creator of all things, was diffused, to make my deeds adorned with the ornament of Thy good-pleasure.

order.why: Keep acceptance of deeds at the center.
Seek help for action that is loved and approved.
Extend that request to all the servants.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O my God, to aid Thy servants unto that which Thou lovest and art pleased with.

order.why: Join love and action to the gifts of knowledge.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O Lord of existence and Educator of the seen and unseen, by Thy Name through which the Salsabil of divine knowledge hath flowed amidst all created things and the seal of the choice Wine hath been broken, to aid Thy servants to love Thee and to gain Thy good-pleasure, and to bestow upon them that which Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones.

order.why: Hear a woman make approved action her hope and desire.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O Light of hearts and Fire of souls and minds, not to disappoint those who hope in Thee from the heaven of Thy nearness and the clouds of Thy bounty. I am she, O my God, who has turned toward the seat of the throne of Thy mercy and has clung to the cord of Thy favors. I beseech Thee to assist me to act according to Thy good-pleasure and to make this my hope and desire in Thy days.

order.why: Ask that a righteous person’s work be accepted.
shortened: O Lord! Dost Thou see any of Thy loved ones who hath turned toward Thy most exalted horizon and held fast to righteousness in Thy days, O Lord of all beings and King of the throne on high and of the dust beneath? Do Thou ordain for him, through Thy bounty and generosity, that which beseemeth Thy grace and bestowal, then accept from him what he hath wrought in Thy path and for Thy good-pleasure.

order.why: Receive blessing for one who has turned and acted.
shortened: Then send down, O my God, upon him who hath turned unto Thee and acted according to that which Thou hast revealed in Thy Book, a blessing from Thee and a mercy from Thy presence.

order.why: Read a person’s prayer to serve in every condition and live the Book.
Ask for service whose effects endure.
shortened: O my Lord! I beseech Thee by the ocean of Thy forgiveness and the heaven of Thy bounty and the sun of Thy grace to aid me in serving Thy Cause and in that which will diffuse the fragrance of Thy good-pleasure and will endure through the endurance of Thy Kingdom.

order.why: Connect service among others with good in every world.
shortened: O my Lord! I beseech Thee by Thy Self to aid me to serve Thee amongst Thy servants, and to ordain for me that which shall profit me in every world of Thy worlds. Verily Thou art the Bestower, the Forgiver, the Merciful.

order.why: Join remembrance with service to the loved ones.
shortened: O my Lord! Aid me to remember Thee and praise Thee and serve Thy Cause and Thy loved ones. Verily Thou art the One Who dominateth the names and createth all things. There is none other God but Thee, the Mighty, the Triumphant, the Powerful, the Hearer, the Answerer.

order.why: Keep the concise petition for remembrance and service.
shortened: I beseech Thee to assist me to serve Thy Cause, to make mention of Thee and to praise Thee.

order.why: Read service through the invocation of the divine Name.
Ask for capacity to arise and speak praise.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which every idolator hath lamented and every believer in unity hath rejoiced, to grant me that which will enable me to arise to serve Thee and to speak in Thy praise.

order.why: Receive the mysteries of knowledge as a reason to serve.
Keep service to the loved ones beside the reward of meeting.
Read the instructed prayer for service and loving-kindness.
Extend the wish to serve to everyone.
shortened: We beseech God to aid all to serve His Cause and to do that which He loveth and is pleased with.

order.why: Ask for strength to accomplish what is loved.
Join assistance to praise and sincerity.
shortened: I beseech God to aid thee to assist His Cause, to enable thee to voice His praise, and to ordain for thee in the Kingdom that which He hath ordained for the sincere ones.

order.why: Receive the simple petition for sincere service.
shortened: O Lord! Assist me with Your confirmations, make me successful through Your aids, and make me one of Your sincere servants.

order.why: Read service as giving life and water to others.
Ask for firmness, knowledge and protection in that work.
shortened: Make him a sign among Thy signs, make firm his feet upon the path, strengthen his loins in Thy service, reinforce his back in worship of Thee, open unto him the doors of Thy knowledge, bestow upon him Thy bounty in full measure, perfect Thy grace unto him, and preserve him through Thy aid, protection and guardianship.

order.why: Let confirmation strengthen resolve and effort.
shortened: Through the manifestations of Thy Kingdom of mercy is my essence revived, and through the confirmations of the Supreme Concourse is my triumph and the exaltation of Thy Word achieved. Through the divine confirmations of Thy most glorious Kingdom is my victory and the soaring of my resolve attained.

order.why: Read certainty and divine knowledge through the gold and Egypt images.
shortened: My Lord, make him mighty in the Egypt of divine knowledge, and pure gold in the treasury of certitude, and assist him with the hosts of Your holy Kingdom in private and in public, and aid him with the armies of Your angels in the realm of creation.

order.why: Ask that one servant become a visible sign of favor.
Extend the request for aid through every world.
Pray for success that becomes a sign of bounty among peoples.
shortened: O Lord! Make them successful in all matters and affairs, make them signs of Thy bounty amongst all peoples, aid them with hosts from Thy holy Kingdom, O Ever-Living, Self-Subsisting One!

order.why: Imagine assistance reaching all continents.
shortened: Aid them with the hosts of divine favors in all regions and support them with the legions of inspiration in all continents.

order.why: Keep the appeal for unseen reinforcement.
shortened: O Thou merciful God, confirm us by Thine invisible hosts and reinforce us through Thy heavenly angels.

order.why: Join aid and nearness to something enduring.
Read provision alongside faithfulness to the Covenant.
shortened: O God, my God! Give me to drink from the cup of Thy bestowal and illumine my face with the light of guidance. Make me firm in the path of faithfulness, assist me to be steadfast in Thy mighty Covenant, and suffer me to be numbered with Thy chosen servants. Unlock before my face the doors of abundance, grant me deliverance, and sustain me, through means I cannot reckon, from the treasuries of heaven. Suffer me to turn my face toward the countenance of Thy generosity and to be entirely devoted to Thee, O Thou Who art merciful and compassionate!

order.why: Ask that protection prevent division among servants.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O my Lord, by Thy most effulgent Name, to acquaint my people with the things Thou didst destine for them. Do Thou, then, preserve them within the stronghold of Thy guardianship and the tabernacle of Thine unerring protection, lest through them may appear what will divide Thy servants.

order.why: Join courage under opposition to harmony and steadfastness.
shortened: O my God! O my God! These are servants whom no blame of any blamer has deterred from Thy love, no assault of any oppressor has prevented from turning to Thee, no attack of any aggressor has frightened from trusting in Thee, and no power of any violator has veiled from prostration before Thee.

Lord! Strengthen them, make them successful, spread through them the divine traces in all regions, manifest through them the mysteries among the people of the East, guard them from discord, guide them to harmony, and make them firm in the Covenant.

order.why: Keep the community firm while receptive to grace.
Retain the storm-surrounded lamp in the plea for steadfastness.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O Lord of the Kingdom of Names, by Thy Most Great and Most Glorious Name, to aid Thy loved ones to such steadfastness as no intimations of the ungodly who have cast behind them Thy proof and Thy testimony, clinging to the idle fancies of the heedless, shall prevent them.

I beseech Thee, O Cleaver of the Dawn, by the Lamp which the tempestuous winds have surrounded, to send down upon Thy chosen ones and Thy trusted ones, from the heaven of Thy bounty and the clouds of Thy generosity, the rain of Thy mercy.

order.why: Join steadfastness with acting according to the Book.
Seek a love undeterred by oppression and doubt.
shortened: Say: Praise be to Thee, O my God, for having aided me to rend asunder the veils and guided me to the Mother Book. I beseech Thee to make me steadfast in Thy love, such that the oppression of the oppressor may not frighten me, nor the might of the heedless, nor the croaking of the croaker, nor the doubts of the learned.

order.why: Read acknowledgment as a call to stand firm.
Bless those who have arisen to serve with what they received.
shortened: O my God! Send Thy blessings upon Thy loved ones who have spoken Thy praise and remembrance, who have arisen to serve Thy Cause and aided Thy religion through what Thou hast bestowed upon them through Thy bounty and generosity.

order.why: Receive gratitude for being remembered during imprisonment.
Bless those undeterred by changing circumstances.
shortened: O my God! Send down Thy blessings upon the people of Baha who were not deterred by the contingencies of fate from turning toward Thy face, O Creator of heaven and Lord of Names!

order.why: Ask for both protection and obedient action amid rejection.
shortened: Say: My God, my God! Thou seest the people of Thy unity amongst the ungodly among Thy creation and the rejecters among Thy servants. I beseech Thee to preserve them through Thy might and power and sovereignty, and to aid them to act according to that which Thou hast commanded them in Thy Book, and to ordain for them the good of this world and the next.

order.why: Remember those prevented from reaching their destination.
shortened: Thou seest, O my Lord, how Thy servants have left their homes in their longing to meet Thee, and how they have been hindered by the ungodly from looking upon Thy face, and from circumambulating the sanctuary of Thy grandeur. Pour out Thy steadfastness and send down Thy calm upon them, O my Lord! Thou art, in truth, the Ever-Forgiving, the Most Compassionate.

order.why: Pray for patience and steadfastness for prisoners.
Keep imprisoned believers within continual remembrance.
Ask directly for the release of loved ones.
shortened: O Thou Who art the Lord of all names and Fashioner of the heavens! Deliver Thy loved ones from the prison of their foes.

order.why: Join deliverance with gathering and hearing.
shortened: O Lord! Behold Thy chosen ones with the glances of Thy loving-kindness, then deliver them, O my God, through Thy power and might, and gather them together in Thy dwelling-place that they may behold Thy beauty and hearken unto Thy call.

order.why: Remember wanderers and captives in the path of love.
shortened: Rather, at all times and moments, in complete humility and supplication at the threshold of the All-Glorious, I beseech and implore: "O Kind Lord! These strangers are wanderers in Thy lane, and these captives are prisoners in the path of love for Thy beauteous countenance. They are Thy helpless ones and the destitute ones in Thy path. Make them the recipients of the glances of Thy merciful eye and bestow upon them the favors of the King of bounty.

order.why: Read continued service amid the sorrow of absence.
Include children and exiles in longing for reunion and service.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O Quickener of bodies and Subduer of all creation, by Thy Most Great Name through which earthquakes have seized all the tribes, to give Thy loved ones and their children to drink from the wine of nearness to Thee and the choice wine of reunion with Thee. Then ordain for them that which will cause them to speak Thy praise, to arise in Thy service, and to turn in all conditions toward Thy luminous countenance shining between the heavens and the earth. O Lord! Aid Thy loved ones who dwell in the land of exile yearning for the breezes of union with Thee and the fragrances of nearness to Thee.

order.why: Remember parents, kindred and fellow believers in the pilgrimage prayer.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O my God, by this House that hath suffered such change in its separation from Thee, that bewaileth its remoteness from Thy presence, and lamenteth Thy tribulation, to forgive me, and my parents, and my kindred, and such of my brethren as have believed in Thee. Grant that all my needs be satisfied, through Thy bounty, O Thou Who art the King of Names. Thou art the most Bountiful of the bountiful, the Lord of all worlds.

order.why: Keep protection and reunion within a personal intercession.
Read the prayer for departure and safe return.
shortened: O thou who hast been remembered in the sight of the Wronged One!  At the hour of departure from the city, say:
O God, my God! I have set out from my home, holding fast unto the cord of Thy love, and I have committed myself wholly to Thy care and Thy protection.
Enable me, then, to return to my home by Thy power and Thy might.

order.why: Remember travelers across varied routes.
shortened: The servant beseecheth his Lord to assist the travelers in what behooveth them on roads and paths, by sea and land, on mountains and hills.

order.why: Retain the reported hope for a safe and pleasant journey.
Keep the precise travel provision for unsaid Obligatory Prayers.
Retain the source introduction to a fasting prayer as supplied.
shortened: This is a prayer that was sent down on the first day of the month of fasting. Well is it with him that supplicateth God -- his Lord, the Most Great, the Almighty, the All-Knowing -- therewith.

order.why: Read fasting as both abstention and guarding the self.
Give the Naw-Ruz festival its distinct setting.
shortened: I give praise unto Thee, O my God, that Thou hast ordained this day as a festival unto such of Thy servants as enjoy near access to Thee and unto Thy loved ones who are devoted to Thyself. Thou didst choose to designate it by this Name, through whose power Thou hast subdued all created things and caused the sweet savours of this Revelation to be diffused amongst all the dwellers of the earth and the inmates of the heavens.

order.why: Read the festival as remembrance extending among humankind.
Receive the appointed day’s joy and blessing.
Keep the reported lunar-month practice attributed to its account.
shortened: For example: whenever in the beginning of the lunar month I happen to look at the crescent of the moon, I raise my two hands with their palms open toward heaven and repeat nine times "Ya Baha El Abha." During all the days of that month, the heavenly Confirmations are experienced and witnessed.

order.why: Preserve the reported Answer and seek its preceding question where the source permits.
shortened: Will you ever return to America again?
Answer by Abdul Baha:

It is in God's hands. Pray for me to return and say: "O Baha'u'llah! Confirm Abdul Baha in the Cause of God. Confirm him in the servitude of God in the East, so that he may not spend all of his time in the Orient, that he may return to America and occupy his time in the Western world."

order.why: Remember a woman together with her household and husband.
Keep the prayers for offspring, protection in Sisan and Covenant together.
Read a woman’s particular petition for an heir.
Keep the request for a noble descendant and future good.
shortened: Compensate him with an illustrious, noble descendant, for Thou art possessed of renewed bounty. Ordain for him every good thing in Thy holy, exalted, and impregnable Kingdom, for Thou art the Generous, the Kind, the Mighty, the Merciful, the Glorious.

order.why: Ask that a son and his kin embody a beloved disposition.
Pray that children arise to serve and praise.
shortened: O Lord! Assist his sons to serve Thy Cause and his children to arise in Thy remembrance and praise amongst Thy creatures.

order.why: Join family remembrance to steadfastness.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O God of Names and Creator of heaven, by Thy greatest signs and the manifestations of Thy grandeur in the kingdom of creation, to assist my family in remembering and praising Thee and in remaining steadfast in Thy Cause.

order.why: Keep the witness in gatherings beside protection for a household.
Receive the prayer for the growth and naming of Ruhiyyih.
Retain the remembrance of a particular mother.
shortened: We have desired to make mention of thy mother from among the people of the household and to give her the glad-tidings of God's loving-kindness, the Goal of them that are endued with insight.

order.why: Keep the assurance of a departed person’s loving attention.
shortened: I swear by the Ancient Beauty that that one who was attracted by the holy fragrances gazes upon you from the Most Glorious Kingdom and awaits the appearance of signs of the flame of the love of God.

order.why: Read the prayer for the Afnan through its stated relationship.
Ask that the Afnans contribute to the life of the world.
Keep the aspiration to serve among the Hands of the Cause.
shortened: I beseech Thee by the mysteries of Thy Most Great Name, and by the lights of Thy countenance, O Lord of eternity, and by the knowledge which no highest consciousness of contingent beings nor loftiest manifestation among created things hath comprehended, to make me one of the Hands of Thy Cause among Thy creatures, that I may arise to serve Thy Cause and make mention of Thee with wisdom and utterance in Thy kingdom.

order.why: Pray for one Hand’s work to gather the scattered.
shortened: O Lord! He is among the Hands of Thy Cause. Strengthen him with the hosts of Thy Kingdom, and aid him to assist Thy Cause, spread Thy signs, and gather those who are scattered from beneath Thy shade.

order.why: Join the Hands’ support to the defenders and heralds of the Covenant.
Remember the Hands’ tranquility as well as their responsibilities.
shortened: And blessings and peace be upon the Hands of Thy Cause, the pathways of Thy guidance, the oceans of Thy knowledge, and the suns of Thy gifts and favors. I beseech Thee to ordain for them that which will gladden their hearts and tranquilize their souls.

order.why: Bless their journeys to guide others.
Read their endeavors through the opening of hearts.
shortened: Magnify, O my God, Thy trusted ones and Thy chosen ones whom Thou hast made the Hands of Thy Cause amongst Thy creation, and through whose high endeavors Thou hast opened the doors of the hearts of Thy servants.

order.why: Keep their steadfastness amid oppression.
Retain the named Muhammad-Husayn’s particular remembrance.
shortened: O my God! Enable Thy servant who was named Muhammad-Husayn to remember and praise Thee, then open his sight with the light of Thy knowledge. O Lord! Thou art the Generous, the Ancient in Bounty. Assist Thy loved ones to whatsoever Thou willest - verily Thou art the Mighty, the Unconstrained.

order.why: Remember another named person’s capacity to praise.
shortened: O Lord! Aid Thy loved ones and him whose name was mentioned before the Throne, that he may arise to celebrate Thy praise amongst Thy creatures and glorify Thee amidst Thy servants.

order.why: Keep the reported account of a man’s prayer for wealth attributed.
shortened: Muhammad-Javad had a brother in Istanbul who was supplicating and entreating God to become rich. The Blessed Beauty prayed on his behalf and promised him prosperity.

order.why: Read the reply about forgiveness of those remembered in prayer.
Preserve the particular request for a blessing upon him.
shortened: Then send down upon him from the heaven of Thy bounty a blessing from Thy presence, O Lord of Names and Creator of earth and heaven!

order.why: Join intercession for another with one’s own petition.
shortened: I beseech Thee not to disappoint him of that which Thou hast ordained for them that are nigh unto Thee among Thy servants and for the sincere ones among Thy creation. O my Lord! Open before my face the doors of Thy generosity and bounty.

order.why: Ask for an opening that guides a woman forward.
shortened: I beseech Thee to open, with the finger of Thy power, a door for Thy handmaiden that will guide her to what befits Thy greatness and Thy sovereignty.

order.why: Receive the handmaidens’ declaration of reliance on divine bounty.
shortened: O Lord! Grant unto Thy handmaidens that which befitteth Thy generosity and beseemeth Thy bounty and grace. They have none besides Thee and have taken no lord except Thee. Thou art the Ocean of Generosity and the Heaven of Bounty.

order.why: Include servants and handmaidens in a common gladness.
shortened: Send down, then, from the heaven of Thy bounty that which will gladden the hearts of Thy servants and Thy handmaidens.

order.why: Remember an individual within the hopes of a wider community.
shortened: O Lord! The eyes of Thy loved ones are fixed upon Thy lights and gazing toward Thy Kingdom and awaiting the appearance of Thy confirmation upon this servant and the lights of Thy bestowal which encompass him through Thy grace and generosity.

order.why: Pray for what is scattered and torn to become a united gathering.
shortened: O Lord! Unite all that is scattered and unify all that is divided and mend all that is torn, and gather Thy loved ones in assemblies of remembrance and praise, and admit Thy servants into gatherings of light and glory, and make them a single tongue speaking Thy praise and attributes among the concourse of creation, steadfast in Thy covenants among the people, humble, submissive, proclaiming, devoted, and supplicating to Thy Most Glorious Kingdom, beseeching Thy most exalted horizon.

order.why: Read humility and service beside the community’s transformation.
shortened: I humble myself before Thee and supplicate to the Kingdom of Thy mercy and the Dominion of Thy oneness, bowing in submission and humility before Thy loved ones, and serving obediently Thy chosen ones. I beseech Thee by Thy penetrating Word that permeates the realities of all things, and by Thy luminous effulgence which hath shone forth, gleamed and illumined the far-reaching horizons, to make Thy loved ones the manifestations of Thy favors, the dawning-places of Thy bounties, the day-springs of Thy knowledge, the mines of Thy love, the orbits of Thy stars, and the sources of Thy signs.

order.why: Imagine a community through stars, trees and lamps.
Ask that faithful souls become signs of mercy for others.
Receive the two birds’ hope of flight and a growing flock.
shortened: O Lord! We are but feeble birds, yet we abide within the shelter of Thy protection. We are lowly fowls dwelling upon the dust, but we seek Thy mighty abode. Broken-winged are we, yet do we yearn to soar unto Thy sublime summits and Thy retreats of celestial glory. Wherefore, bestow upon us Thy favour and grant us Thy strength, that we may acquire wings of felicity, may take flight in this limitless space, and become intimates of Thy Kingdom of Glory. Grant Thou that, through the union of these two unrestrained birds, a flock of the meadows of truth may emerge and soar within the lands of divine unity.

order.why: Retain the prayer for friends as a life-giving company.
Join freedom from attachment with being present and active in service.
Imagine loved ones becoming visible signs of oneness.
shortened: O my Lord! Make Thy loved ones therein the speaking signs of Thy oneness and the manifest, brilliant and lofty banners of Thy singleness, and the towering landmarks of Thy manifest religion, and the evident and radiant emblems of Thy traces.

order.why: Remember those whose generosity built a House of Worship.
Join their material offerings with nearness and spiritual light.
Pray for a city through the lives of its inhabitants.
shortened: O my God! This is a city wherein the fire of Thy love hath blazed, and the lights of Thy knowledge have shone. Make then its precincts illumined, its environs fragrant, its courts spacious, and its happiness immense, through the light of Thy Divine Unity which shineth from that city in every direction of that region; and make Thou Thy loved ones therein the waves of the sea of Thy oneness, the troops of the hosts of Thy knowledge, the trees of the garden of Thy bestowal, and the fruits of the tree of Thy providence.

order.why: Give Kashan its particular place in that concern.
shortened: O Lord! Make Kashan radiant with light and make that region a paradise of delight, that the song of "Glory be to the Holy One, Lord of the angels and the Spirit" may reach the Most Glorious Horizon and bestow joy and fragrance upon the people of the Supreme Concourse.

order.why: Read the hope for a land marked by martyrdom to become a garden.
shortened: My God, my God! This is a land that was watered by holy, sacred, pure blood. You brought it to life through the spirit of the supreme martyrdom, and the Blessed Tree was watered by it, and it was reddened by the blood of holy souls in the place of sacrifice. O Lord! Make this region the Garden of Paradise and cause springs of pure water to flow from its rocks. Plant therein the trees of unity and cause them to grow beautifully through the outpouring of the cloud of divine confirmation. Make it the dawning-place of lights, the dayspring of divine traces, and the source of mysteries.

order.why: Keep the reported prayer for Paris and its need for spiritual life.
shortened: O God! This Paris is a lamp in the utmost transparency but it is in need of the light. It is a body in the greatest of comeliness but it is in need of the Spirit. O God illumine this lamp. And confer life upon this body! It is a pity that Paris be deprived of Thy eternal Bestowals! It is a pity that a great city like unto this be prevented from obtaining the splendors of the Sun of Thy Mercy!

order.why: Ask for justice and grace upon the throne of the world.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O Master of eternity, to bless the throne of the world through the Dawning-Place of Thy justice and the Dayspring of the Sun of Thy grace, that thereby all who dwell in existence, both seen and unseen, may be illumined.

order.why: Repeat that concern for the thrones of the world.
shortened: When thou hast drunk the Choice Wine sealed from the hand of the bounty of thy Lord, the Self-Subsisting, say: My God, my God! Adorn the thrones of the world with the manifestations of Thy justice and the dawning-places of Thy grace.

order.why: Seek justice and fairness as an illumination.
shortened: Yet the servants have attempted to extinguish the light with swords of hatred. We beseech God to illumine them with the light of justice and adorn them with the ornament of fairness.

order.why: Read crowns of equity beside knowing the path and balance.
shortened: Adorn their heads with the crowns of justice and equity, and illumine their hearts with the light of Thy knowledge, O Thou Who art the Lord of the Kingdom of immortality and Who hast manifested Thyself through Thy Most Great Name, the All-Glorious.
Ordain for them that which will draw them nigh unto Thee, and make them to know Thy path, Thy balance, Thy testimony and Thy proof.

order.why: Join justice, knowledge and steadfastness.
Move from relatives toward trustworthiness among all on earth.
Pray for guidance reaching everyone.
shortened: We beg of Thee, O Providence, to show Thy way unto all men, and to guide them aright. Thou art, verily, the Almighty, the Most Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Seeing."

order.why: Ask that bounty’s doors open upon the world.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Thy light wherewith Thou hast illumined the hearts of Thy chosen ones, and by the fire of the Tree of Thy utterance whereby the hearts of Thy loved ones were set ablaze, to open, through the key of Thy Most Great Name, the doors of bounty and generosity upon the world.

order.why: Read remembrance of a martyr beside grace for all peoples.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Him Whom Thou didst name 'Ali in Thy Book, who was martyred in Thy path in the Land of Ya, to open through the key of Thy Most Great Name the doors of Thy grace and bounty unto all peoples.

order.why: Imagine a withered world becoming alive and receptive.
Keep the reported appeal for humanity’s illumination.
shortened: O Thou Kind Beloved! Illumine the world of humanity! Enlighten the hearts with the effulgence of Thy Love! Perfume the nostrils with Thy sweet Fragrances. Confer upon us a new Bestowal! Give unto us a strong power! Open the eyes! Make the ears hearing!

order.why: Confront the devastation of war in prayer for peace and forgiveness.
Keep the hope of receiving what is ordained for trusted ones.
shortened: I beseech Thee not to disappoint me in attaining that which Thou hast ordained for Thy trusted ones.

order.why: Ask mercy for servants and handmaidens through the image of flowing water.
shortened: My God, my God! Have mercy upon Thy servants and handmaidens, and withhold them not from the Kawthar of Thy mercy which hath flowed from Thy Most Exalted Pen in the garden of inner meanings by Thy command.

order.why: Seek nearness through the divine names and signs.
shortened: I beseech Thee by the Dawning-Places of Thy Most Beautiful Names and the Daysprings of Thy Most Exalted Attributes and by Thy Greatest Signs, to send down upon Thy servants that which will draw them to the Most Exalted Horizon and bring them nigh unto Thee, O Lord of all beings and King of the throne on high and of the dust below.

order.why: Remember promises of good within the Book.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Thy greatness which hath encompassed all created things, and by Thy power which hath prevailed over all contingent beings, to ordain for Thy loved ones who have turned toward the Dayspring of Thy Revelation and entered the court of Thy Cause every good thing which Thou hast sent down in Thy Book and promised them in Thy Scriptures and Tablets.

order.why: Give longing and the pain of separation their full devotional place.
shortened: O God! O my God! These are servants whose hearts have been ignited with the fire of Thy love, whose patience has been severed due to their separation from beholding the lights of Thy countenance, whose tears flow from the surging of their longing for Thy holy threshold, and in whose innermost beings burn the fires of anguish from being seized by the hardships of separation from Thy sacred court of oneness.
Verily Thou art the Almighty, the Powerful, the Ever-Living, the Everlasting, the Capable, the Dominant, the Self-Subsisting.

order.why: Read the many forms of need and their corresponding petitions.
shortened: O Lord, O Thou the Compassionate! These souls are a gathering of Thy lovers and friends, devoted to Thy Path, enamored of Thy countenance, and bewildered in search of Thee.

They are thirsting for the sweet waters of Thy favors - lead them to the Most Great Ocean. They are lost in the desert of longing - show them the way to the pavilions of reunion. They are captives in the chains of Thy love - free them from every bond. They are guides to the straight path of Thy good-pleasure - grant them guidance. They thirst for Thy heavenly spring - give them to drink. They are wounded by the arrows of separation from Thee - gladden them with the breezes of the tidings of union.

order.why: Receive the call to continued supplication.
shortened: I pray that they may unloose their tongues, may supplicate and implore continually, and may seek confirmation from the threshold of the one true God.

order.why: Ask that doors of grace open through remembrance of the Prophets.
shortened: Say: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Prophets and Thy chosen ones and Thy loved ones to send down upon me from the heaven of Thy bounty a grace from Thee and a mercy from Thy presence. Then open before my face the doors of Thy gifts and favors.

order.why: Seek enduring remembrance, benefit and joy.
shortened: Then ordain for me in the kingdom of Thy Cause that whereby my remembrance may endure, my being may profit, and my heart may rejoice.

order.why: Receive nourishment from the heavenly table.
shortened: Ordain for me the good things that are with Thee, and nourish me from the Table Thou didst send down out of the clouds of Thy bounty and the heaven of Thy favor.

order.why: Keep the Night Journey within the prayer’s own imagery.
Remember Yathrib and Batha in a petition for steadfast love.
Read love for created things through their relation to the Creator.
Join the good of this world and the hereafter.
Keep the blessing upon the first illumined one and those who entered Paradise.
shortened: Therefore, O my God, send Thy blessings upon the first one who was illumined by Thy light and who shone forth through the dawning of the sun of Thy Self-Subsistence and who was made resplendent through the resplendence of the moon of Thy sanctity, and upon those who entered Thy most exalted Paradise and Thy most glorious Ridvan and who drank from the cup of Thy love in the most sublime heights and the most sheltered habitations.

order.why: Pray for a community undeterred from its vision.
Receive good in both worlds without forgetting remembrance.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O my God, by this Day and by Him Whom Thou hast made the Dawning-Place of Thy revelation and the Dayspring of Thine inspiration, to ordain for Thy loved ones the good of this world and the next, and to make them of those whom nothing besides Thee can occupy from Thy remembrance and praise.

order.why: Retain the source’s concern about rejecting received bounty.
Ask for the good of the Book and spiritual power.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Thy manifest light and by the fire of Thy love which blazeth forth on the Day of Judgment, to ordain for Thy loved ones all the good Thou hast sent down in Thy Book. Then adorn them, O my God, with the ornament of glory and power.

order.why: Receive the wish for aid through the means of heaven and earth.
shortened: And we beseech Him to aid them with the means of the heavens and the earth, and to ordain for them from the Pen of Destiny that which befitteth the ocean of His bounty and the heaven of His grace and the sun of His bestowals.

order.why: Keep shared recognition beside the plea to turn in all conditions.
shortened: "Praise be unto Thee, O God of the world, for having numbered us among them who have attained unto Thy recognition in Thy days and who have voiced Thy praise when most of Thy creatures turned away from Thee. O Lord! We beseech Thee by Thy Most Glorious Name, which hath been made sovereign over all names, to make us in all conditions turn toward Thy face, gaze upon the horizon of Thy grace, drink from the Kawthar of Thy knowledge, seek refuge with Thy presence and cling to the cord of Thy bounty. Then ordain for us that which shall profit us and that which Thou hast written for Thy chosen ones.

order.why: Ask for the good appointed to the people of Baha.
shortened: Then I beseech Thee by Thy most great signs and the manifestations of Thy grandeur amidst mankind to ordain for Thy servants that which Thou hast ordained for the people of Baha. Verily Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest.

order.why: Preserve the brief appeal not to be deprived of favors.
Receive the request for all the good in the Book.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O Lord of existence and Sovereign of the seen and unseen, by the ocean of Thy generosity and the heaven of Thy grace, to ordain for me all the good Thou hast sent down in Thy Book.

order.why: Read the seeker’s turning with hope in mercy.
shortened: O my Lord! Thou seest the supplicant turning toward Thy Most Great Gate, and the seeker facing the direction of Thy bounty, O Lord of eternity! Ordain for him what befitteth Thy generosity, O Thou in Whose grasp is the reins of bounty! O my Lord! Deprive me not of the wonders of Thy grace. Ordain for me all the good Thou hast ordained in Thy Book. Verily Thou art the Compassionate, the Giving, the Forgiving, the Merciful."

order.why: Remember the sincere servant beneath the cloud of mercy.
shortened: Therefore, O my God, I beseech Thee by Thy manifest signs in the temples of unity and Thy resplendent traces in the manifestations of oneness, to ordain for him every good thing Thou hast ordained in the kingdom of Thy creation for Thy sincere servants, and to send down upon him the outpourings from the cloud of Thy greatest mercy's heaven.

order.why: Extend the good of the Book to all who have turned.
shortened: O Lord! Ordain for those who have desired Thee and turned to Thee in Thy days every good thing that was in Thy Book.

order.why: Keep the marked omission within the renewed appeal for opened gates.
Receive bounty through the images of heaven, mountains and nightingale.
Keep the supplied bracketed terms in the prayer for both worlds.
Receive the simple image of an opened door.
Read shared good through the Word that unites peoples.
Remember steadfastness through the good of both worlds.
Let the brief appeal for mercy stand on its own.
Read the reported wish for inspiration and universal love.
Imagine enlarged capacities through the eagle and stars.
Ask for a voice capable of conveying hidden meanings.
Close with attentive senses, generous hands and steadfast feet for a transformed life.
shortened: Then I ask Thee, O my Beloved, by Thy Most Glorious Beauty, to grant us tongues that are eloquent, fluent and clear; eyes that are penetrating, sharp and keen; faces that are illumined and radiant; lips that are smiling and cheerful; ears that are attentive and perceiving; hearts that are sanctified and serene; souls that are purified and well-pleasing; hands that are upraised and outstretched; and feet that are firm, steadfast and upright; and breaths that are influential and pure, that Thou mayest transform all who are on earth entirely through Thy command and will, and draw them near to the shore of Thy Most Great Sea, that all may testify that verily Thou art God, there is no God but Thee, the Beloved in the hearts of the lovers, and the One Desired in the hearts of them that long for Thee.

questions: What do the prayers that admit uncertainty suggest about the relationship between asking, trust, and knowing what is good for us?
How do these readings make room for grief, loneliness, material need, gratitude, and joy within the same devotional life?
What changes when prayer includes people beyond ourselves, including family, prisoners, opponents, and whole cities?
How do repeated petitions for knowledge, justice, steadfastness, and service connect inward devotion with outward conduct?
What can the Lord’s Prayer and Psalm 13 help us notice about daily needs, forgiveness, lament, and trust in these prayers?
Which image or petition would you like to dwell with further, and which connected prayer subject might deepen that exploration?

references.label: 1 · Matthew 6:5–13 · Daily need and divine will
references.note: Jesus teaches prayer without seeking an audience or relying on many words, then offers a prayer joining divine will, daily bread, forgiveness, and deliverance. Compare this combination with petitions for practical relief and inward transformation in the compilation. How might words received from a sacred text become attentive personal prayer?

references.label: 2 · Psalm 13:1–6 · Lament within trust
references.note: The psalm gives voice to prolonged sorrow and the sense of being forgotten, asks to be heard, and turns toward trust and song. Read its movement beside the compilation’s prayers for relief from loneliness, agitation, and separation. Consider how lament and praise can belong within a continuing relationship with God.
